about: evident-charts house colors. Light background only in v1. cr = WCAG contrast vs #FFFFFF. Validate any change with scripts/check_palette.py --preset all.

token_notes.accent: focal series/bar; cr 3.87, marks and large text only
token_notes.accent_alt: focal series when warm reads as alarm or topic is neutral; cr 5.19, text ok
token_notes.context_gray: non-focal series; cr 1.88, below 3:1 only when focal data is accented and direct-labeled
token_notes.text: title 12.63; axis titles, tick labels, annotations 7.00; subtitle, source 4.54 (floor on white)
token_notes.gridline: value axis only; cr 1.25 by design
token_notes.spine: left/bottom only, or remove when value labels replace the axis; cr 3.36

slots.name: bluish green
slots.use: lines, marks; same lightness as vermillion, direct-label

slots.name: orange
slots.use: fills with dark outline, or direct-labeled only

slots.name: sky blue
slots.use: fills with dark outline, or direct-labeled only

slots.name: yellow
slots.use: never lines or text on white; outlined fills only

viridis.marks_note: hex_marks = viridis 0.0-0.85 for dots/lines/bars on white; full ramp for heatmaps/choropleths

diverging.domain: symmetric [-m, 0, m], m = max(|min|, |max|); never TwoSlopeNorm or unequal arms
diverging.order: hex lists run low->high in ColorBrewer order (RdBu red->blue, PuOr orange->purple), same as matplotlib; d3 and Vega PuOr run purple->orange. Flip: matplotlib '_r', ggplot2 direction, reverse the range elsewhere

okabe_ito.ggplot2: scale_colour_manual(values = c(...slots)); not palette.colors('Okabe-Ito'), whose order differs

blues.vega: blues (Vega's own ramp, not ColorBrewer hexes)

sources: Okabe & Ito (jfly.uni-koeln.de/color); ColorBrewer (Apache-2.0); viridis/cividis (CC0, sampled from matplotlib 3.10)
